'''Tyrok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he worked as the personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for [[Valarian/Legends|Lady Valarian]], a major [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Valarian's long rival [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] ordered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill Tyrok to disrupt Valarian's business. The spacer then Tyrok in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] and killed him.<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyrok was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tyrok was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|Jabba's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> One of the missions from Jabba himself asked the player to kill Tyrok.<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" />
